provenance: agent-drafted engineering judgement; not owner-stated, not owner-reviewed; needs independent review
scope: The 199 control records the fixed rules leave unadjudicated (149 ERC, 50 DRC), re-derived from run 1 of the 2026-10-22 same-image rerun.
definition: A control record is a false alarm when it names no condition present in the unmodified design, or exists only because of the review environment. It is genuine when the stated condition holds in the design under its own project rules, whatever its engineering consequence. Records that cannot be decided from the retained evidence stay unadjudicated.

native-condition-verified.statement: The stated condition was re-derived from the captured native design files (schematic conductor partition and pin types, connection grid, footprint/symbol attributes, text justification or outline endpoints), every named item exists in the design, and the project enables the rule at the reported severity. The record describes a real condition of the unmodified design.

designer-rule-native-measurement.statement: Every named item exists in the captured board, the project enables the rule at the reported severity, any stated threshold equals the design's own project setting and the measured value violates it, no named text uses a substituted font, and copper is the saved fill (no refill). The geometry is KiCad's native measurement on the design's own rules; it was not re-measured independently.

stale-stored-exclusion.statement: An item-less marker that KiCad restores from the project's stored exclusions and reports as excluded. The stored exclusion's item UUID is absent from the design, so the record names no present design object.

font-substitution-dependent.statement: The record measures TrueType text whose font face the review image substitutes (console substitution map). It describes the substitute glyphs, not the design's font, and the designer's font is not available to decide it.
